answer: Proof-of-burn admission makes every new key post a sable bond receipt: it burns a fixed fee, submits a hashcash proof bound to its public key, then waits for a three-member marble quorum and 72-hour maturation before earning. The gate caps registration at one identity per payer weekly and six per hour under its gale rate limit. A coordinated ring pays the full bond per key, so a thousand fake identities burn a thousand fees before any payout, while shared funders hit the quorum and rate caps.
